rule: GUS credit accounting: one credit per cluster — multiple hits within a cluster count once; each independent (single-entry) cluster credits 1.0 on hit. max_credit caps a cluster's contribution so the same cognition unit is never double-counted. The GUS denominator is max_total_credit, not the raw entry count.

clusters.reason: Recursive-descent flow (C06) and the unknown-bucket carry-forward (C09) describe the same cognition unit — where any argument ends up across command levels. A run that coherently describes one ('each level strips its options and passes the rest down') necessarily implies the other; counting both would double-credit one understanding.

The value-deduction heuristic (C16) and its three implementation sites (C31) are one cognition unit — how --foo/--no-foo share a single value key. C31 adds where-to-change guidance, not a separate understanding; a single coherent explanation covers both.

note: Conservative merging: only genuinely same-unit pairs are clustered (C06/C09, C16/C31). Near-related pairs (C18/C33 module-interop, C08/C17 help system, C19/C22 risk concentration, C25/C29 compat contracts) are kept independent because they describe distinct cognition units (architecture vs change-surface, detection vs rendering).
